profile.headline: President, Data Vision Systems
profile.summary:
In over thirty+ years of IT consulting, which has focus on the areas of IT certification and professional training, Stan has logged thousands of classroom-training hours.  Having worked with a wide range of personalities in various locales, Stan adapts easily to new environment where he can function as a team player as well as to provide leadership when necessary.  Stan is the President and founding partner of Data Vision Systems (www.datavizionsystems.com)  - a Microsoft Silver Partner. As a lead instructor and consultant he has developed and delivered many training and consulting solutions on a wide variety of platforms inclusive of:  
•	OS & DevOps: Novell, Window, Linux, Android, Puppet, Citrix, HPC
•	Cloud Solutions: Azure, AWS, Google, Data Science, ML, AI  
•	SSAS & PAAS:  Office 365, Dynamics 365, Docker, Kubernetes
•	Messaging: GroupWise, Mail, Exchange
•	ERP & eCommerce: Commerce Server 2x, AX Retail, NAV, SL
•	Microsoft Dynamics: CRM, RMS, POS, NAV, AX, GP, SL, AX-365
•	SOA and Integrated Solutions: BizTalk, Penthao
•	Security & Edge Solutions: Wireshark, Information Protection
•	Frameworks: JavaScript, Angular JS, Delphi, C, C++, .NET & Core (C#, VB, F#), Ionic, node.js, Spring, Java, RXJava, LINQ, Lua, Scala, Python, X++, R, PHP, Vue, CFScript, C/SIDE, FORTRAN, COBOL, Perl, Assembly, PowerShell, React, ColdFusion
•	Mobile: Android, Eclipse, Windows Phone
•	Database: SQL, Oracle, MySQL, DB-2, PeopleSoft, Neo4j, Firebase, PostgreSQL, Essbase, Dynamo, Neo-4j
•	BI Solutions:  SSRS, SSIS, SSAS, MDX, PowerBI, IBM-Initiate
•	Big Data: AWS, Hadoop, Pig, Hive, Azure, Oozie, HDFS, HDInsight
•	Communication: OCS, Nortel, Lync Server, Skype for Business
•	Virtualization: Hyper-V, VMWare, XanApp, AppV, MED-V, Docker 
•	Project Management: Project, Project Server
•	Web: HTML 5, JavaScript, CSS3, MVC, .NET, Drupal, Xamarin
•	Data Science &AI: AWS, R, MATLAB, Python, Mahout, Spark
